name: 粗花呢拼接滑雪套装（米白色）
description:
米白色滑雪套装，上衣的肩袖、前胸和雪裤膝盖拼接毛绒粗花呢，其余是光面防水面料，软糯又有质感，男生女生都能穿。
只有米白色（最后一张是三色对比图，仅供参考）。尺码 M。

## 面料与科技
- 防水指数 ＞20000mmH₂O（实测，GB/T 4744-2013）
- 防水等级 4–5 级（实测，GB/T 4745-2012）
- 透湿量 ＞15000 g/m²·24h（实测，JIS L1099-2021）
- 色牢度 4–5 级（实测，GB/T 5713-2013）
- 三层复合面料：外层高密度，防泼水、防油污、耐磨；中层防水透气膜；内层亲肤抓绒
- 全身接缝 18mm 宽压胶，雪水不易渗入，同时防风
- 内里抓绒轻薄保暖，官方标称 -30℃ 锁温

## 设计细节
- 肩袖、前胸、膝盖拼接毛绒粗花呢，其余为光面防水面料
- 连帽设计
- 全身抽绳调节扣，可按身形调整松紧
- 两侧大容量口袋
- 普通腰头雪裤（不是背带裤），直筒版型
descriptionEn:
A cream ski suit with fluffy tweed panels on the shoulders, sleeves and chest of the jacket and on the knees of the pants; the rest is smooth waterproof fabric. Soft, textured and unisex.
Cream only (the last photo shows all three colors for reference). Size M.

## Fabric & Tech
- Waterproof rating >20,000 mmH₂O (lab tested, GB/T 4744-2013)
- Water resistance grade 4–5 (lab tested, GB/T 4745-2012)
- Breathability >15,000 g/m²/24h (lab tested, JIS L1099-2021)
- Colorfastness grade 4–5 (lab tested, GB/T 5713-2013)
- 3-layer fabric: dense shell that resists water, oil and abrasion; waterproof breathable membrane; soft fleece lining
- All seams sealed with 18 mm tape to keep out snowmelt and wind
- Light, warm fleece lining, rated by the brand to −30°C (−22°F)

## Design Details
- Fluffy tweed panels on the shoulders, sleeves, chest and knees; smooth waterproof fabric elsewhere
- Hooded jacket
- Drawcord adjusters throughout for a custom fit
- Two roomy side pockets
- Regular-waist pants (not bibs) with a straight fit

- Metal stud trim along the seams
- Stand collar and long front zip for easy on and off
- Straight legs for a longer-looking line

name: 银色山泉满钻牛仔滑雪套装
nameEn: Silver Mountain Spring Rhinestone Denim Ski Suit
description:
山泉系列满钻牛仔套装（银灰色）：银灰色水洗牛仔质感夹克 + 同色系阔腿裤，全身铺满亮钻，同款还有其他两个颜色。尺码 S。

## 面料与科技
- 内里抓绒，蓄热锁温，官方标注适合 0℃ 到 -10℃
- 防水防风外层，雪地里摔了也不容易湿

## 设计细节
- 牛仔质感面料上铺满大小亮钻，阳光下特别闪
- 立领 + 门襟暗扣，挡风
- 胸前两个大翻盖口袋，工装感
- 宽松直筒裤，裤脚拉链方便穿脱雪鞋
descriptionEn:
Rhinestone denim set from the Mountain Spring series (Silver): a silver-grey washed-denim jacket with matching wide-leg pants, covered in rhinestones from top to bottom. Also available in two other colors. Size S.

## Fabric & Tech
- Fleece lining that holds in heat; rated by the brand for 0°C to −10°C (32°F to 14°F)
- Waterproof, windproof shell — stays dry even after a fall

## Design Details
- Denim-look fabric covered in rhinestones of different sizes — it really sparkles in the sun
- Stand collar with a covered placket to block the wind
- Two big flap chest pockets for a workwear feel
- Relaxed straight-leg pants with zippered cuffs that open over ski boots

name: 浅粉亮钻蝴蝶结滑雪套装
nameEn: Pale Pink Rhinestone Bow Ski Suit
description:
浅粉色连帽滑雪套装：胸前、袖子和裤腿上缀着满钻蝴蝶结和粉色飘带，玫粉色拉链点缀，甜美又有闪光点。尺码 M。

## 面料与科技
- 防水指数 ＞20000mmH₂O（实测，GB/T 4744-2013）
- 防泼水等级 4–5 级（实测，GB/T 4745-2012）
- 透湿量 ＞15000 g/m²·24h（实测，JIS L1099-2021）
- 色牢度 4–5 级、耐磨 ＞500000 次（实测）
- 呼吸式疏水透湿膜，汗汽排得出，不积湿
- 内里贴肤磨毛暖绒，无冷点，活动时发热升温（官方标称 +4.5℃）

## 设计细节
- 加高防风领，风大时不用缩脖子
- 下摆可收紧抽绳，防钻冷风
- 扩容裆部、立体裁剪膝部，大幅活动不束缚
- 立体无绗缝设计，好活动、更保暖
descriptionEn:
A pale pink hooded ski suit with rhinestone-covered bows and pink ribbons on the chest, sleeves and legs, finished with rose-pink zippers. Sweet, with plenty of sparkle. Size M.

## Fabric & Tech
- Waterproof rating >20,000 mmH₂O (lab tested, GB/T 4744-2013)
- Water repellency grade 4–5 (lab tested, GB/T 4745-2012)
- Breathability >15,000 g/m²/24h (lab tested, JIS L1099-2021)
- Colorfastness grade 4–5; abrasion resistance >500,000 cycles (lab tested)
- Breathable hydrophobic membrane lets sweat vapor out so you stay dry
- Brushed fleece lining with no cold spots; warms up as you move (rated +4.5°C by the brand)

## Design Details
- Extra-high windproof collar
- Drawcord hem to seal out cold air
- Roomier crotch and articulated knees for full freedom of movement
- Quilt-free construction that moves easily and stays warm

name: 浅蓝星星毛边背带雪裤
nameEn: Light Blue Star Faux-Fur Bib Snow Pants
description:
浅蓝色背带雪裤：裤腿两侧和背带都镶着白色毛绒边，胸前和裤腿上缀着蓬蓬的白色毛绒星星，腰间一条白色毛绒腰带配金属扣。软萌又有设计感。只租背带裤，图里的白色猫耳外套不包含。尺码 M。

## 设计细节
- 背带款，护住后腰不进雪
- 背带长度可调
- 白色毛绒包边从背带一路延伸到裤脚
- 毛绒腰带可调节松紧
- 宽松直筒裤型，活动不受限
descriptionEn:
Light blue bib snow pants with white faux-fur trim running down the straps and legs, fluffy white stars on the bib and legs, and a plush white belt with a metal buckle. Soft, playful and very photogenic. Bib pants only (the white cat-ear jacket in the photos isn't included). Size M.

## Design Details
- Bib style keeps snow out of your lower back
- Adjustable shoulder straps
- White faux-fur piping from the straps all the way to the hems
- Adjustable plush belt
- Relaxed straight-leg fit for easy movement

name: 奶白工装连体滑雪服
description:
奶白色工装风连体滑雪服：上身是短款工装造型，高立领、胸前两个翻盖大口袋，黑色拉链和袖口拇指套做撞色；下身是黑色修身微喇裤，腰间一条黑色腰带，看起来像两件套，其实是一件连体。干净利落，很显腿长。
⚠️ 尺码偏小：S 码，适合体重 50kg（100 斤）左右的女生。

## 面料与科技
- 防水指数 ＞20000mmH₂O（实测，GB/T 4744-2013）
- 防水等级 4–5 级（实测，GB/T 4745-2012）
- 透湿量 ＞15000 g/m²·24h（实测，JIS L1099-2021）
- 色牢度 4–5 级（实测，GB/T 5713-2013）
- 三层复合面料：外层高密度，防泼水、防油污、耐磨；中层防水透气膜；内层亲肤抓绒
- 全身接缝 18mm 宽压胶，雪水不易渗入，同时防风
- 内里抓绒轻薄保暖，官方标称 -30℃ 锁温

## 设计细节
- 连体设计，腰部不进雪
- 高立领挡风，胸前两个翻盖大口袋
- 腰带可调节，收腰显腿长
- 修身微喇裤脚，袖口拇指套防风
descriptionEn:
A cream utility-style ski jumpsuit: the top has a cropped workwear look with a tall stand collar, two big flap chest pockets and black contrast zips and thumbhole cuffs; the bottom is slim black flared pants with a black belt at the waist. It looks like two pieces but it's one jumpsuit. Clean, sharp and leg-lengthening.
⚠️ Runs small: size S, best for women around 50 kg (110 lb).

## Fabric & Tech
- Waterproof rating >20,000 mmH₂O (lab tested, GB/T 4744-2013)
- Water resistance grade 4–5 (lab tested, GB/T 4745-2012)
- Breathability >15,000 g/m²/24h (lab tested, JIS L1099-2021)
- Colorfastness grade 4–5 (lab tested, GB/T 5713-2013)
- 3-layer fabric: dense shell that resists water, oil and abrasion; waterproof breathable membrane; soft fleece lining
- All seams sealed with 18 mm tape to keep out snowmelt and wind
- Light, warm fleece lining, rated by the brand to −30°C (−22°F)

## Design Details
- One-piece design keeps snow out of your waist
- Tall stand collar and two big flap chest pockets
- Adjustable belt for a defined waist
- Slim flared legs; thumbhole cuffs to seal out wind

name: 黑灰反光小恶魔滑雪套装
description:
黑灰拼色几何滑雪套装，灰色拼块是反光面料，晚上被灯一照整片发亮。帽子上有一对立体小恶魔角，肩上一对可拆的蝙蝠翅膀和尖刺，又酷又搞怪，男生女生都能穿。
尺码 M。
descriptionEn:
A black-and-grey geometric ski suit whose grey panels are reflective, so they light up under night lights. The hood has a pair of 3D devil horns, and detachable bat wings and spikes sit on the shoulders. Edgy, playful and unisex.
Size M.

name: 柠檬黄扎染滑雪套装
description:
奶白底晕染柠檬黄的扎染滑雪套装，白色拉链和黑色细节点缀，宽松廓形，在雪地里清新又显眼。
尺码 S。
descriptionEn:
A cream ski suit washed with lemon-yellow tie-dye, finished with white zips and black accents. Relaxed and oversized, fresh and easy to spot on the snow.
Size S.

name: 粉色亮片爱心滑雪套装
description:
浅粉色宽松滑雪套装，上衣和裤子缀满大大小小的闪亮爱心，甜美少女感拉满。
尺码 M。
descriptionEn:
A pale pink relaxed ski suit scattered with sparkly hearts in all sizes on the jacket and pants. Sweet through and through.
Size M.

name: 粉紫星星拼色滑雪套装
nameEn: Pink & Lilac Star Colorblock Ski Suit
description:
粉色、浅紫和白色的山峰形拼色滑雪套装，胸前两颗紫色星星，背后一颗大大的白色星星，复古又俏皮。
尺码 M。
descriptionEn:
A pink, lilac and white colorblock ski suit with mountain-peak panels, two lilac stars on the chest and one big white star on the back. Retro and playful.
Size M.

name: 云灰冰川滑雪套装
description:
从白色渐变到浅灰蓝的滑雪套装，全身点缀亮钻十字图案，上衣和裤子都有工装大口袋，干净高级，男生女生都能穿。
尺码 M。
descriptionEn:
A ski suit that fades from white to soft grey-blue, dotted with rhinestone cross motifs, with utility cargo pockets on both the jacket and pants. Clean, elevated and unisex.
Size M.

name: 梦幻彩色扎染满钻滑雪套装
description:
粉、黄、蓝、紫柔和晕染的彩色扎染滑雪套装，全身铺满细密亮钻和十字钻饰，阳光下一闪一闪，梦幻又仙气。
尺码 M。
descriptionEn:
A dreamy pastel tie-dye ski suit in soft pink, yellow, blue and lilac, covered in tiny rhinestones and rhinestone crosses that sparkle in the sun.
Size M.

name: 黑色腊肠狗滑雪套装
description:
黑色滑雪套装，前襟一条奶白色撞色拼条，全身印着穿小毛衣的腊肠狗，可爱又不幼稚。
尺码 S。
descriptionEn:
A black ski suit with a cream contrast placket, printed all over with little dachshunds in sweaters. Cute without being childish.
Size S.

name: 海蓝之谜滑雪套装
nameEn: Mystery of the Ocean Ski Suit
description:
湖水蓝渐变到深炭灰的滑雪上衣，配同色湖蓝雪裤，水钻像雪花一样从肩膀洒落下来，男生女生都能穿。和「玫瑰之谜」是同一个系列。
尺码 M。
descriptionEn:
An aqua ski jacket that fades into deep charcoal, with matching aqua pants and rhinestones that scatter down from the shoulders like falling snow. Unisex. From the same series as Mystery of the Rose.
Size M.

name: 紫色星光满钻滑雪套装
description:
深紫色滑雪套装，胸前和裤腿用亮钻拼出一簇簇星光，金属质感的 ISEE MIGGA 刺绣标，浓郁又闪耀。
尺码 M。
descriptionEn:
A deep purple ski suit with bursts of rhinestone starlight across the chest and legs and a metallic ISEE MIGGA script logo. Rich and sparkly.
Size M.

name: 墨色山泉满钻牛仔滑雪上衣
nameEn: Ink Mountain Spring Rhinestone Denim Ski Jacket
description:
「墨色山泉满钻牛仔滑雪套装」的上衣单独出租：深灰黑色牛仔质感夹克，全身铺满亮钻。只租上衣，图里的裤子不包含。尺码 L。
搭配任意黑色雪裤都很好看，可以在 Mix & Match 挑一条黑色雪裤自己搭。

## 面料与科技
- 内里抓绒，蓄热锁温，官方标注适合 0℃ 到 -10℃
- 防水防风外层，雪地里摔了也不容易湿

## 设计细节
- 牛仔质感面料上铺满大小亮钻，阳光下特别闪
- 立领 + 门襟暗扣，挡风
- 胸前两个大翻盖口袋，工装感
descriptionEn:
The jacket from the Ink Mountain Spring Rhinestone Denim Ski Suit, rented on its own: a charcoal-black denim-look jacket covered in rhinestones. Jacket only — the pants in the photos aren't included. Size L.
It looks great with any black snow pants — pick a pair from Mix & Match.

## Fabric & Tech
- Fleece lining that holds in heat; rated by the brand for 0°C to −10°C (32°F to 14°F)
- Waterproof, windproof shell — stays dry even after a fall

## Design Details
- Denim-look fabric covered in rhinestones of different sizes — it really sparkles in the sun
- Stand collar with a covered placket to block the wind
- Two big flap chest pockets for a workwear feel
